decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (526.P0.001-A and 526.P0.002-A received: 30 March 2017. 526-P1.001-B, 526-P1.003-C, 526-P1.011-B, 526-P1.012-C, 526-P1.013-C, 526-P1.014-C, 526-P1.015-B, 526-P1.101-D, 526-P1.102-D, 526-P1.103-C, 526-P1.111-C, 526-P1.112-B, 526-P1.113-C, 526-P1.114-D, and 526-P1.115-C received: 22 May 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The side-facing window formed on the side dormer shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 6 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
description: Erection of a side and rear roof extension incorporating two front roof windows to the house
